2.web: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
2.asv: No doubt but ye are the people, And wisdom shall die with you.

3.web: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
3.asv: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: Yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

4.web: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.
4.asv: I am as one that is a laughing-stock to his neighbor, I who called upon God, and he answered: The just, the perfect man is a laughing-stock.

5.web: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
5.asv: In the thought of him that is at ease there is contempt for misfortune; It is ready for them whose foot slippeth.

6.web: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their God in their hands.
6.asv: The tents of robbers prosper, And they that provoke God are secure; Into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.

7.web: “But ask the animals, now, and they shall teach you; the birds of the sky, and they shall tell you.
7.asv: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; And the birds of the heavens, and they shall tell thee:

8.web: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach you. The fish of the sea shall declare to you.
8.asv: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee; And the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

9.web: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the hand of Yahweh has done this,
9.asv: Who knoweth not in all these, That the hand of Jehovah hath wrought this,

10.web: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
10.asv: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind?

11.web: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
11.asv: Doth not the ear try words, Even as the palate tasteth its food?

12.web: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
12.asv: With aged men is wisdom, And in length of days understanding.

13.web: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
13.asv: WithGodis wisdom and might; He hath counsel and understanding.

14.web: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
14.asv: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again; He shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

15.web: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
15.asv: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up; Again, he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

16.web: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.
16.asv: With him is strength and wisdom; The deceived and the deceiver are his.

17.web: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.
17.asv: He leadeth counsellors away stripped, And judges maketh he fools.

18.web: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
18.asv: He looseth the bond of kings, And he bindeth their loins with a girdle.

19.web: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
19.asv: He leadeth priests away stripped, And overthroweth the mighty.

20.web: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
20.asv: He removeth the speech of the trusty, And taketh away the understanding of the elders.

21.web: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
21.asv: He poureth contempt upon princes, And looseth the belt of the strong.

22.web: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
22.asv: He uncovereth deep things out of darkness, And bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

23.web: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
23.asv: He increaseth the nations, and he destroyeth them: He enlargeth the nations, and he leadeth them captive.

24.web: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
24.asv: He taketh away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, And causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

25.web: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
25.asv: They grope in the dark without light; And he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
